lines.text:
Look at what Team Rocket have done to
my house!\c
And they stole my TM, the one that can teach
Pokémon like Mankey and Sandshrew
the move Dig...

Oh, you retrieved the TM?
Thank you very much!\c
You can keep that, though. I’ve decided to take
my time training Diglett and have them learn Dig
that way.
Team Rocket must be trying to dig their way\ninto something no good!
There is a hole in the wall.\nYou can get out using the hole.
